title: Sharing habits with friends
body: I love the app and it’s super productive but I wish it had an option for you to share habits with your friends. Where you and your friends can see each other’s habits and improve on them.
author: jadaeroms

title: After two weeks of using
body:
Here are few things you should work on
1, the app should be able to be synchronized across all devices so that you can track same habit on all devices you are sign in on, eg. using my tablet and my iPhone 
2, your habits should be saved, so this you sign in or delete the app and uninstall the app. The next time you reinstall and sign in, your habit saved should automatically appear.
